name: medicine ball half kneeling chest push
description: A half kneeling chest pass motion with a medicine ball that trains pushing power and core stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Push the ball forward explosively or against a wall.
Catch it or bring it back to your chest.
Switch the kneeling leg after your set.
